title: Abafuni Beqiniso Abalele
intro: Cabanga ngesikhathi lapho inkolelo yayiphikiswa khona, futhi iqembu lemiphefumulo lakhetha ukuqiniseka okungenakunyakaziswa kunokunethezeka kwezwe. Bebhekene nokukhetha okunzima, bafuna indawo yokukhosela, baqala uhambo olwaholela ebuthongweni obungavamile. Indaba yabo iwubufakazi bokuvikelwa kwaphezulu kanye namandla okholo ekucindezelweni. Ungakwazi yini ukubona ukuthi bangobani laba bantu abaphawulekayo?
clues: Sasiyiqembu elincane, sihlanganiswe yinkolelo ejulile kuMdali Oyedwa.
Sasiphila esikhathini lapho umbusi onamandla wayefuna ukukhulekelwa komunye umuntu ngaphandle kuka-Allah.
Ukuze silondoloze ukholo lwethu, sanquma ukushiya amakhaya ethu futhi sibalekele ukucindezelwa.
Umngane othembekile, isidalwa sasemhlabeni, wayehamba nathi ohambweni lwethu.
Sithole indawo yokukhosela endaweni engasese, lapho u-Allah wasenza salala ubuthongo obujulile nobude.
Lapho sivuka, sasikholelwa ukuthi usuku noma ingxenye yosuku kuphela eseludlulile, kodwa amakhulu eminyaka ayesedlulile ngempela.
arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
